data.name: Aslam
data.gender_notes: Aslam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aslam is a serene Arabic name meaning 'most peaceful', 'purest', or 'one who submits fully to God'. It reflects a calm, righteous personality rooted in Islamic spirituality and humility. The name Aslam carries the meaning “Peaceful, Safer, Pure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Aslam usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful, safer, pure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes submission to Allah, inner peace, and spiritual safety. A name representing purity of heart and peaceful nature.
data.etymology: Aslam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Peaceful, Safer, Pure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aslam total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: اسلم
in_arabic.long_meaning: ٱلَّذِٓينَ اِسْلَمُوا وَهُمْ مُجْرِمُونَ وَٱتَّقُوا يَوْمًا لَا تَجْزَعُونَ وَٱذْكُرُوا ٱلنَّدِيَةَ حَتّىٰ يَأْتِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَنْزِعُونَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَيُضَٰعِفُونَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَسَنَةً وَٱدْخُلُوا ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱمْسَاكًا وَلَا حَوْفَةً وَأَنْفِقُوا مِنْ مَآءٍۢ وَلَا رَعِيَةٍۢ تَخَافُونَ رَدَّهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ ثُمَّ لَمْ يُقِلَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَالرِّزْقُ مِنْ عِبَادِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ

in_urdu.name: اسلم
in_urdu.meaning: وہ لوگ جنے نے Islam قبول کیا اور وہ مرتکب گناہ ہیں۔
in_urdu.long_meaning: وہ لوگ جنے نے اسلام قبول کیا اور وہ مرتکب گناہ ہیں اور اللہ سے ڈرتے رہیں اور اس دن کا انتظار نہ کرو جس دن تمہیں اپنے مال و دولت سے محروم کیا جائے گا اور اللہ کے رسولﷺ سے یاد کرو جس نے تمہیں پانی کے لیے اور جنت کے باغات کی جانب کی ہدایت کی ہے جس سے تمہیں ڈر ہو۔ اللہ تعالیٰ جب تمہیں اس زمین میں داخل کرتا ہے تو تمہیں کچھ نہیں کہہ سکتے بلکہ اللہ کے فضل سے اور اللہ کے رحمت سے تمہیں کچھ ملا ہے اور اللہ کا رزق بڑے ملاک کے ایک ہی بندے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: असलम
in_hindi.meaning: वह लोग जिन्होंने ईमान (इस्लाम) कुबूल किया और वे अपराधी हैं
in_hindi.long_meaning: वह लोग जिन्होंने ईमान कुबूल किया और वे अपराधी हैं और अल्लाह से डरते रहें और जिस दिन का इंतजार न करें जब उन्हें अपना धन और माल से محروم कर दिया जाएगा और अल्लाह के रसूल से याद करें जिन्होंने उन्हें पानी के लिए और जन्नत के बागों की ओर की हिदायत दी है जिससे उन्हें डर हो۔ अल्लाह ने जब उन्हें इस धरती में प्रवेश किया तो उन्हें कुछ नहीं कहा गया बल्कि अल्लाह की रहमत से उन्हें कुछ मिला है और अल्लाह का रजा बड़े मालिक के एक ही बंदे हैं।

in_english.name: Aslam
in_english.meaning: Those who submit to Islam and are guilty of sin
in_english.long_meaning: Those who submit to Islam and are guilty of sin and remain God-fearing and do not despair of Allah's mercy and remember Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) who guided them to water (of faith) and the gardens of Paradise and fear Allah's punishment and know that the provision comes from the Lord of the Worlds, not from any other source and that Allah is the provider and sustainer of all His creation.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aslam carries a rich cultural heritage, being rooted in the Arabic language and Islamic traditions. In many Muslim cultures, the name is associated with a deep sense of peace, tranquility, and submission to the will of God.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Aslam carries a deep spiritual significance as it symbolizes the journey of a Muslim towards a closer relationship with God. It serves as a reminder of the importance of inner peace, submission, and purity of the soul in Islamic spirituality. The name also reflects the desire to live a peaceful and righteous life, striving to serve Allah and contribute positively to the Muslim community.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Aslam means "free from error" or "innocent" in Arabic. It is a beautiful name that symbolizes the pure and sinless nature of Allah (swt) and the ideal that Muslims should strive to attain in their actions and thoughts.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Aslam was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad and took part in several battles, including the Battle of Badr and the Battle of Uhud.
